question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**of**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is: *"The last one of this long procession (1) _______ silent men and women was a little wizened old man."*
 
• Here, the preposition **‘of’** is used to show belonging or association.
 
• The phrase **“procession of silent men and women”** means the procession consists of silent men and women.
 
• Other options like **for, to,** and **in** do not convey the correct relationship between “procession” and “silent men and women.”

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1 – of**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **of** – shows belonging or composition (correct choice).
 
• **for** – shows purpose (incorrect here).
 
• **to** – shows direction or relation (doesn’t fit context).
 
• **in** – shows location (not appropriate here).
